text:
four straight missiles from Seykota:

this is Seneca/Socrates level of understanding duality:

Q: Do great traders have a special talent for trading? 
A: Good traders have a special talent for trading just as good musicians and good athletes have talents for their fields. Great traders are ones who are absorbed by the talent. They don't have the talent— the talent has them.

Q: What is the balance between talent versus work in trading success? 
A: I don't know where one starts and the other stops.

Q: How much of a role does luck play in trading success? A: Luck plays an enormous role in trading success. Some people were lucky enough to be born smart, while others were even smarter and got born lucky.

Q: What effect has trading had on your personal life?
A: My personal life is integrated with my trading life.
